check: Classify the use case by impact or risk tier before build or procurement, and record the reasoning.
Run a documented risk and impact assessment that names affected groups (including vulnerable groups) and the harms considered.
Involve legal and data protection review from concept stage; run a data protection impact assessment where personal data is processed at risk.
applies_when: data_types includes any of {personal, sensitive_personal, biometric, health, financial}

check: Fix metrics and acceptance thresholds before testing, scaled to stakes, including whether pass criteria are absolute or comparative.
Record why the chosen metrics and benchmarks are valid for the deployment context, and the limits of what the tests cannot show.
Validate training, validation and test data for quality, provenance, lawfulness and representativeness.
Check that test data reflects the local deployment setting (population, language, geography) and under represented groups.
Test accuracy and task performance on diverse datasets in deployment like conditions.
Test for bias and unequal performance across subgroups.
Test robustness: perturbed inputs, outliers and extreme cases, and run to run stability.
Analyse failure modes and confirm fail safe or graceful degradation behaviour.
Run security testing: secure code review, vulnerability scanning, penetration testing, and AI specific attacks (prompt injection, poisoning, evasion).
Test for privacy leakage and re identification risk.
applies_when: data_types includes any of {personal, sensitive_personal, biometric, health, financial}

check: For generative or agentic systems, run structured red teaming and harmful output and refusal tests, and test whole workflow and tool use behaviour.
For vendor or black box systems, secure contractual access for testing and verify vendor performance claims independently, using alternative methods where internals are closed.
Design human oversight and test that override and review actually work, with trained reviewers.
Obtain independent review scaled to impact level (qualified expert reviewers, independent assessors, or notified body style assessment).
Make a documented go or no go decision at an authority level matched to the impact tier, with a rule for unacceptable residual risk.
Keep reproducible evidence: test data versions, protocols, results and logs.
Publish or disclose a summary of tested performance and fairness results as appropriate to the audience.
Monitor performance, drift, outcomes, complaints and human overrides on a schedule.
Define re testing triggers: model or data change, vendor update, scope change.
Set incident escalation, suspension and rollback procedures.

Healthcare entity licensed by Abu Dhabi Department of Health: check each applicable clause of the DoH Responsible AI Standard V1 (validation, safety testing, security review, representativeness audits, risk assessment, conformity assessment for high risk).

Healthcare entity regulated by Dubai Health Authority: check the DHA AI in Healthcare Policy (independent third party validation, certification, auditable validation statements, regular independent audits).

Determine whether the federal personal data law applies to the entity and the data (Article 2 excludes government data and government entities controlling or processing personal data), then, if it does, check the impact assessment and security testing duties.

check: DIFC or ADGM entity: check the DIFC Data Protection Regulations Regulation 10, the Commissioner's Accreditation and Certification Framework, and the ADGM data protection and FSRA guidance that applies.

Dubai government entity: check the Dubai AI Ethics Guidelines and self assessment tool, the AI Integration Matrix Framework, and the DESC Information Security Regulation controls on testing and sign off.
